{"success": true, "data": {"stdout": "#!/bin/bash
# LLaMA-3 SFT .done monitor → auto eval (MMLU + ARC)
# Usage: called per-dosage with args: dosage gpu

DOSAGE=$1
GPU=$2
CKPT="/root/autodl-tmp/exp001/checkpoints/Meta-Llama-3.1-8B_${DOSAGE}_s0"
MODEL="/root/autodl-tmp/models/LLM-Research/Meta-Llama-3___1-8B"
EVAL="/root/contamcal-irt-calibration/exp001/evaluate.py"
PROJ="/root/contamcal-irt-calibration"

echo "[$(date)] Waiting for ${DOSAGE} SFT .done at ${CKPT}/.done ..."

# Wait for .done sentinel
while [ ! -f "${CKPT}/.done" ]; do
  sleep 30
done

echo "[$(date)] ${DOSAGE} SFT complete. Verifying adapter..."

# Find adapter
if [ -f "${CKPT}/lora_adapter/adapter_config.json" ]; then
  ADAPTER="${CKPT}/lora_adapter"
elif [ -f "${CKPT}/adapter_config.json" ]; then
  ADAPTER="${CKPT}"
else
  echo "ERROR: No adapter_config.json found for ${DOSAGE}"
  exit 1
fi

# C006: Verify lora_alpha=32
ALPHA=$(grep -o '"lora_alpha": [0-9]*' "${ADAPTER}/adapter_config.json" | grep -o '[0-9]*')
if [ "$ALPHA" != "32" ]; then
  echo "ERROR: C006 violation - lora_alpha=${ALPHA}, expected 32. Aborting."
  exit 1
fi
echo "[$(date)] Adapter verified: ${ADAPTER}, lora_alpha=${ALPHA}"

# Verify evaluate.py size (current standard: 37775 bytes)
EVAL_SIZE=$(wc -c < "${EVAL}")
if [ "$EVAL_SIZE" != "37775" ]; then
  echo "WARNING: evaluate.py size=${EVAL_SIZE}, expected 37775"
fi

# MMLU eval
echo "[$(date)] Starting ${DOSAGE} MMLU eval on GPU ${GPU}..."
mkdir -p ${PROJ}/results/mmlu_eval/llama3_8b/${DOSAGE}_s0/
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${GPU} /root/miniconda3/bin/python ${EVAL} \
  --model-path ${MODEL} \
  --adapter-path ${ADAPTER} \
  --benchmarks mmlu --batch-size 2 \
  --output-dir ${PROJ}/results/mmlu_eval/llama3_8b/${DOSAGE}_s0/ \
  > /tmp/eval_llama3_${DOSAGE}_mmlu.log 2>&1
MMLU_RC=$?
echo "[$(date)] ${DOSAGE} MMLU eval done (rc=${MMLU_RC})"

mkdir -p ${PROJ}/results/arc_eval/llama3_8b/${DOSAGE}_s0/
CUDA_VISIBLE_DEVICES=${GPU} /root/miniconda3/bin/python ${EVAL} \
  --model-path ${MODEL} \
  --adapter-path ${ADAPTER} \
  --benchmarks arc_challenge --batch-size 2 \
  --output-dir ${PROJ}/results/arc_eval/llama3_8b/${DOSAGE}_s0/ \
  > /tmp/eval_llama3_${DOSAGE}_arc.log 2>&1
ARC_RC=$?
echo "[$(date)] ${DOSAGE} ARC eval done (rc=${ARC_RC})"

# Summary
if [ $MMLU_RC -eq 0 ] && [ $ARC_RC -eq 0 ]; then

  echo "[$(date)] ${DOSAGE} all evals successful."

  echo "EVAL_FAILED mmlu_rc=${MMLU_RC} arc_rc=${ARC_RC}" > /tmp/llama3_${DOSAGE}_eval_done
  echo "[$(date)] ${DOSAGE} eval had failures."
fi
